pairs.Supers: Gathering Storm, Feast of Light: Aegis contradicts itself: tab Swap +77.3 % (25038 / 14122), tab Abilities +63.3 % (11767 / 7207), and the text allows at most +70 % (Compendium: 'up to 70% increased Super Damage'). The model gives +65.8 % (Jolt share unscaled; 66.5 % before the 1 s charge of One Thousand Voices, the probe's weapon, shifted its keyword damage), between the tabs and within the text.
pairs.Supers: Blade Barrage, Knock 'Em Down, S: Aegis contradicts itself: tab Swap +77.0 % (23150 / 13076), tab Abilities +102.2 % (25864 / 12795); the model gives +80.9 %, 3.9 points above Swap and 21 below Abilities. The cause of the tab difference is not known; the 25 % of Sharp Edges alone cannot explain either.
pairs.Heavy: One Thousand Voices, Ember of Ash: Aegis Sustained multiplies its Base by 11 shots; the Base comes from 4 measured shots with 2 ignitions (without Ember) and 4 (with Ember), so it counts half the shots igniting without Ember. Over 11 real shots the model fires 5 and 11 ignitions. On the 4 measured shots the model's Ember ratio lies +0.6 % off Aegis (tests/scenarioBench.test.ts).

As without the catalyst: Aegis' Base comes from 8 measured shots with 4 and 8 ignitions, the model fires 5 and 11 over 11 shots. On the 8 measured shots the model's Ember ratio lies +1.4 % off Aegis (tests/scenarioBench.test.ts).
